```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Payment System

  Scenario: User logs in and views prescription
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user views their prescription
    Then the prescription is displayed with full details

  Scenario: User views invoice
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user views their invoice
    Then the invoice is displayed with full details

  Scenario: User makes payment
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    And the user has a valid prescription
    When the user makes a payment using a debit/credit card
    Then the payment is successful and the prescription is marked as paid

  Scenario: User makes payment using net banking
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    And the user has a valid prescription
    When the user makes a payment using net banking
    Then the payment is successful and the prescription is marked as paid

  Scenario: User views email with prescription and invoice
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user views their email with prescription and invoice
    Then the email contains the full prescription and invoice details

  Scenario Outline: Browser and OS support
    Given the user is using <browser> on <os>
    When the user accesses the prescription and payment system
    Then the system is accessible and functional

    Examples:
      | browser | os        |
      | Chrome  | Windows 10 |
      | Firefox | macOS      |
      | Safari  | iOS        |
      | Edge    | Windows 10 |

  Scenario Outline: Payment methods
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user makes a payment using <payment_method>
    Then the payment is successful

    Examples:
      | payment_method |
      | Debit Card     |
      | Credit Card    |
      | Net Banking    |

  Scenario: Email content validation
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user views their email with prescription and invoice
    Then the email contains the full prescription and invoice details

  Scenario: Unsupported browsers
    Given the user is using an unsupported browser
    When the user accesses the prescription and payment system
    Then the system displays an error message indicating unsupported browser

  Scenario: Edge cases
    Given the user is logged in with valid credentials
    When the user views their prescription with a large number of items
    Then the prescription is displayed with full details
```
